name: activity-timeline
title: Activity timeline
description: Lists timestamped events with actors and optional expandable details.
docs: Vlak leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/vlak-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

vlak.snippet:
1. 5 September, 10:00

    Revision published
vlak.example:
import { ActivityTimeline } from "@noorddev/vlak-react";

<ActivityTimeline events={[{ id: "release", title: "Revision published", dateTime: "2026-09-05T10:00:00Z", actor: "Studio", description: "Updated the vehicle controls", details: "Numeric baselines and playback spacing are now shared." }]} />

use: Audit history, project activity, and chronological event records.
avoid: Steps toward a goal; use Stepper or TaskProgress.

keyboard.does: Tab reaches each summary; Enter or Space expands the native disclosure.

a11y: An ordered list with machine-readable time elements. Optional details use native disclosure semantics.
